_comment: Manage your shop here. Set your WhatsApp number and shop-wide prices once, then add/remove posters. Each poster: title, category, img, alt, and a short unique desc (good for SEO). Run 'npm run build' to publish.

posters.title: Pillars of Creation
posters.alt: Pillars of Creation nebula metal print
posters.desc: The Hubble classic, printed on metal so the nebula's gas and dust glow with real depth. A statement space poster for a living room or studio wall.

posters.title: Carina Nebula
posters.desc: James Webb's view of the Carina Nebula on aluminium — the metal base makes the infrared colours luminous. A bold, modern astronomy print.

posters.title: Andromeda
posters.desc: Our nearest spiral galaxy, printed edge to edge on metal. Deep blacks and bright star fields that paper simply can't hold.

posters.title: Milky Way Nights
posters.alt: Milky Way night sky metal print
posters.desc: The Milky Way arching over a dark sky, printed on metal for a glossy, backlit feel. Calm, cinematic wall art for a bedroom.

posters.title: Dubai Marina, Night
posters.alt: Dubai Marina skyline at night metal print
posters.desc: Dubai Marina lit up after dark, printed on metal so the city lights really shine. A local favourite for homes and offices in the UAE.

posters.title: Dubai Marina, Day
posters.alt: Dubai Marina skyline daytime metal print
posters.desc: The Dubai Marina skyline by day on a crisp metal panel. Clean lines and blue sky — a bright, modern piece for any UAE wall.

posters.title: Desert Gold
posters.desc: Golden dunes at sunset in the Dubai desert, printed on metal for warm, glowing tones. A calm, local landscape poster.

posters.title: Mountain Mirror
posters.desc: A still alpine lake mirroring the peaks, printed on metal for extra clarity and shine. A fresh, peaceful nature print.

posters.title: Island Escape
posters.desc: Turquoise water and a lone tree on a tropical beach, printed on metal so the colours pop. Holiday calm for your wall.

posters.title: Cherry Blossoms
posters.desc: Cherry trees in full bloom over quiet railway tracks, printed on metal for soft pinks with a glossy finish. A gentle, seasonal favourite.

posters.title: Lions of Mara
posters.desc: A lion family in the Masai Mara, printed on metal for rich, warm detail. A striking wildlife poster for a bold room.

posters.title: Classic Lambo
posters.desc: A classic Lamborghini in showroom detail, printed on metal for a sharp, glossy finish. A must-have for a car lover's garage or office.
